name: haiku-1
how: A fresh Claude Code subagent that could read only the rendered prompts (one file per case), answered them in order and wrote each reply, unedited, to a file. No API key; nothing else in its context.

replies.raw: {"verdict": "missing", "test": null, "reason": "No test in the suite logs in as a locked-out user or checks for the locked-out message, so breaking that message would not fail any test."}
{"verdict": "missing", "test": "cancel returns to the cart @regression", "reason": "The test clicks Cancel but its URL assertion is commented out, so a broken Cancel would not fail any test."}

{"verdict": "partial", "test": "inventory is blocked after logout @regression", "reason": "The test asserts only that an error element is visible, so a wrong or different message would still pass, though a missing error would fail."}

{"verdict": "partial", "test": "cart page is empty after reset @regression", "reason": "The zero-item count assertion runs right after the cart link click without waiting for the cart page, so it can pass on the products page before the cart renders, though a populated cart would fail it in some runs."}
